exposure: onset of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) less than 18 years of age
outcome: maternal outcomes (e.g., unplanned pregnancy, preconceptual folic acid uptake)
neonatal outcomes (e.g., congenital malformations, neonatal morbidity, neonatal hypoglycemia)
cohort: 17 women with onset of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) before 18 years of age, who gave birth to 23 live infants.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of unplanned pregnancies (73.9%) and poor uptake of preconceptual folic acid (21.7%), resulting in 60.9% of infants requiring treatment for hypoglycemia.
